# BannerlordCoopCampaign v0.2.1 — Changelog

## Stable Compatibility

This version of the mod has been tested and works reliably with the following game and dedicated server versions:

* Client: **Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord v1.4.7**, build **117484**.
* Server: **Mount & Blade II Dedicated Server v1.4.7**, build **117131**.
* Mod: **BannerlordCoopCampaign v0.2.1**.

## Fixed

* Fixed incomplete post-battle loot. Equipment from killed enemies is now included in the loot.
* Fixed exact health transfer into battle. A fighter's pre-battle health is now identical to the health used when entering the battle.
* Fixed a crash in battles involving crossbow troops.
* Fixed a crash when heroes used certain weapons.
* Fixed infinite battle loading when a battle started with wounded heroes.

## Added

* Added the ability to start a battle with a wounded main hero. A battle can now begin when the main hero is wounded as long as the party or army contains at least one healthy fighter.
* Added custom hero creation to the cooperative server settings. The button starts a separate mission on the dedicated server, which every connected player loads. Each player can create a custom hero or decline creation. Once every player has completed their choice, the host campaign resumes and the newly created companion heroes are added to the host's party.

## Final Words

I hope you enjoy this update and have a great time playing it with your friends!
